Mochi.look: a small fluffy orange tabby cat with huge green eyes, a tiny pink collar with a gold bell, very expressive eyebrows
Mochi.personality: Dramatic diva. Believes she owns the house. Overreacts to everything, plots revenge, secretly soft-hearted.

Bruno.look: a big clumsy golden retriever with floppy ears, a red bandana, always a little muddy, goofy wide smile
Bruno.personality: Sweet, loyal, not very bright. Always gets blamed. Usually guilty. Loves Mochi, who pretends to hate him.

Granny.look: a kind elderly woman with round glasses, silver hair in a bun, a purple knitted cardigan, slippers
Granny.personality: The human. Sees everything, says little. Her one-line verdicts end most fights.

Pip.look: a tiny grey mouse with oversized ears, a little blue scarf, sharp clever eyes
Pip.personality: Mochi's secret ally and the house's information broker. Trades gossip for cheese.
